image_points_to_world_plane — CALIB plane op

• Data kinds: table → keypoints

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.image_points_to_world_plane(cam_par, pose, image_points, scale=1.0) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import calib; calib.image_points_to_world_plane(cam_par, pose, image_points, scale=1.0), registry से लेना हो तो opscalib.get("image_points_to_world_plane"))

उपयोग

camera के intrinsics/extrinsics से pixels को world plane z=0 पर back-project करता है (image_points_to_world_plane)।
